description: This file defines the HistoryAdapter class, a RecyclerView adapter for displaying a list of calculation history entries in an Android application. It creates and binds views for each history item, managing the display of timestamp, expression, and result, including accessibility features and item removal functionality.

classes.name: HistoryAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter that manages and displays a list of calculation history entries, providing view creation, data binding, item removal, and accessibility support.

classes.name: HistoryAdapter.ViewHolder
classes.description: A ViewHolder that holds references to the views displaying timestamp, expression, and result for each history entry.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates view holder by programmatically constructing the view hierarchy for a history item.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data from a calculation history entry to the views in the ViewHolder, setting texts and accessibility descriptions.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of history entries.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes a history entry from the list at the specified position and notifies the RecyclerView.
